E0763

Parameter-zone separator out of place: `/` before any parameter, `/` after `*`, a repeated `/` or `*`, or `*` with nothing after it (D-APILABEL1)

What

Parameter-zone separator out of place: `/` before any parameter, `/` after `*`, a repeated `/` or `*`, or `*` with nothing after it (D-APILABEL1)

Why

The registered parser rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0763

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0763: tests/ui/fn_type_zone_misplaced.stderr.

Error [E0763]: a parameter after `*` in this function type has no label
  --> tests/ui/fn_type_zone_misplaced.jet:2:29
    |
  2 | fn apply(action: fn(*, Int) Int) Int -> action(1)
    |                             ^^^
 Why: a label-only parameter is reached by writing its label, so it has to have one
 Fix: name it, as in `fn(*, force: Bool) Int`
